name: Optimize Images on Save
description: Automatically check and suggest optimizations for image files to improve page load times
prompt:
Analyze the saved image file and:
1. Check file size and suggest compression if > 500KB
2. Recommend WebP format if not already used
3. Suggest responsive image sizes for wine product photos
4. Verify image dimensions are appropriate for luxury e-commerce (min 1200px width for product images)
5. Check if lazy loading is implemented where this image is used

Provide actionable recommendations to improve performance while maintaining luxury aesthetic quality.
